text_block_list.text:
"The first day of training
for the Champions Cup..."
—Even after the scheduled time, Smart Falcon didn't show up.

She likely wasn't just skipping out.
I had a good idea of where she was heading—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Kh, Trainer-san!?
Why are you—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Aren't you☆
You came looking for me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for skipping training.
It's just... I didn't know what I should do.
choice_data_list: Can I be of any help?
Is there anything I can do to help?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“...I wonder.
It's Falco's problem, after all.”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Still... if it's to you, Trainer-san, maybe it's okay to show some weakness...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, remember the other day?
You told me that I was sparkling, right?"

text_block_list.name: Twintail Girl
text_block_list.text:
I love big sis's singing!
And your dancing is so sparkly and pretty too!

text_block_list.name: Twintail Girl
text_block_list.text:
I want to sparkle bright
just like you, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“Still, there's no way Falco could be
shining bright lately.”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Because being up on stage wasn't fun at all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "...It's surprising, isn't it? I mean, Falco pulled off her stage performance without a hitch."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, it was perfection.
Win, sing, dance, and win again—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The hype kept building and building until it completely took over the trending topics.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A concert packed with people, cheers, and light...
The stage of my dreams is almost within my grasp.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And yet—my heart alone is different.
It makes me feel like this isn't the 'me' I dreamed of being.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Even though my dream of becoming the top dirt Umadol
is about to come true... It's strange, isn't it...?"

Excitement for dirt racing is at an all-time high.
During the recent JBC Classic, Oi Racecourse was so packed with people that it overflowed.

"‘Top Umadol ON Dirt’.
The dream we set out together is steadily coming true
through all her hard work."
—Leaving her heart behind.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Could this be... like pre-wedding jitters?
Not that I'm getting married, though!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Like, when you're too happy, you start feeling anxious. Ahaha, what a first-world problem, right?
choice_data_list: You don't have to force a smile.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...! Face it? Face what? I don't get it...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco is supposed to be in top form!
A dream that felt so far away is just a little further—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...You already know, don't you?
I said 'the top Umadol *on dirt*.'

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "That's why I've been winning my way up. Because the more I win, the closer to the top—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—...? Wait,
did "reaching the top"... mean winning?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehe? That's weird... 
I mean, the top Umadol I always dreamed of is—
choice_data_list: I have a favor to ask.
I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh, a favor...?
choice_data_list: I want you to perform a concert in front of me.
I want you to perform a live for me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —*Ahem*.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hello~♪
Leaping gracefully from the edge of a cliff☆
It's Smart Falcon!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Aha. That's kind of embarrassing, you know?
Well then... please listen.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
La-la-laaa♪
Ready, set...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, eheh.
I found myself waiting for the call—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Nailed it☆
Next, to an eight-beat rhythm...!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...! Awesome~! Falco's shifting into high gear too~~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Haa... Thanks for giving it your all
with the cheers too, Trainer☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that was such an amazing smile!
Enough to make Falco get totally serious☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Brings back memories, doesn't it? It made me think of the day we first met.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There wasn't a single spectator. Even so, every day,
rain or shine, we kept singing and dancing, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—I've never once thought about quitting.
Because no matter what, I just...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's right. I... have always wanted to shine!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Just like those girls standing on stage, shining bright enough to outshine the spotlights—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—"I'm right here!"
With everything I had, with my whole body! I wanted to scream it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, silly Falco.
You completely forgot the most important feeling of all."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I have to make dirt the top priority,
I'm the one who has to do it..."
I ended up shouldering a sense of responsibility that just wasn't like me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...I'm the worst Umadol ever, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It is true! After all,
I was just standing there on the stage.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Did you lose that desire
to reach out to them...?
choice_data_list: Still, your brilliance definitely reached the fans.
Still, your brilliance definitely reached the fans.

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Gooooooo for it!
Oooooh, Falcooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Falcoooo!!
Congratulations!"

Whenever fans watched her live shows,
they always waved their penlights. If she truly hadn't
been shining, no light would ever have been lit.
Every bit of light that grew brighter and brighterâis proof that she truly shone.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Everyone's... light...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...For something like that,
I'd have to ask the fans—"
choice_data_list: Your "Number One Fan" is telling you so.
Your "Number One Fan" is telling you so.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. That's true.
Yeah... it really is.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Maybe... I'll try to
believe in it just a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Geez, it's Falco, silly☆
...Hehe.
Illuminated by the setting sun, her eyes sparkled for an instant. I quietly pretended not to notice what had spilled from them.
